title: Codzienna praca
subtitle: daily, retro, podmiana, klient, ticket i Slack

translations.pl: Na daily mówię, co skończyłam wczoraj
translations.en: In the daily I say what I finished yesterday
accept: At standup I say what I finished yesterday
In the daily I say what I completed yesterday
translations.note: na spotkaniu jesteś in the daily; wczoraj zamyka sprawę → finished

traps.input: In the daily I say what I have finished yesterday
traps.why: Yesterday zamyka sprawę — wtedy nigdy have. Zostaje finished.

traps.input: On the daily I say what I finished yesterday
traps.why: Na spotkaniu jesteś in: in the daily, in the retro, in the meeting.

translations.en: Today I'm taking a regression ticket
accept: Today I am taking a regression ticket
I'm picking up a regression ticket today
translations.note: dziś, konkretny plan na ten dzień → I'm taking

traps.input: Today I take a regression ticket
traps.why: I take opisuje nawyk. Gdy mówisz, co robisz dzisiaj: I'm taking.

translations.pl: Blokuje mnie brak dostępu do środowiska
translations.en: I'm blocked by missing access to the environment
accept: I am blocked by missing access to the environment
Lack of environment access is blocking me
translations.note: coś blokuje CIEBIE → I'm blocked by

traps.input: I'm blocking by missing access to the environment
traps.why: To brak dostępu blokuje Ciebie, więc I'm blocked. I'm blocking znaczyłoby, że to Ty kogoś blokujesz.

translations.en: I'll finish this before noon
accept: I will finish this before noon
I'll get this done before noon
translations.note: obietnica podjęta w rozmowie → I'll finish

traps.input: I finish this before noon
traps.why: Gdy właśnie decydujesz, co zrobisz, idzie I'll finish.

translations.en: I don't have any blockers
accept: I have no blockers
I don't have blockers
translations.note: w przeczeniu → don't have any

traps.input: I don t have some blockers
traps.why: W przeczeniu idzie any, nie some: I don't have any blockers.

traps.input: I haven't any blockers
traps.why: Samo haven't nie wystarczy. Albo I don't have any, albo I haven't got any.

translations.en: After the daily I go back to testing
accept: After standup I go back to testing
After the daily I get back to testing
translations.note: wracam do czegoś → go back to + -ing

traps.input: After the daily I go back to test
traps.why: Po go back to idzie rzeczownik albo forma z -ing: go back to testing.

translations.pl: Na retro mówię, co poszło dobrze
translations.en: In the retro I say what went well
accept: At retro I say what went well
In the retrospective I say what went well
translations.note: mówisz o minionym sprincie → what went well

traps.input: In the retro I say what goes well
traps.why: Retro podsumowuje to, co już było, więc went.

translations.en: We were missing acceptance criteria
accept: We missed acceptance criteria
We didn't have acceptance criteria
translations.note: brakowało nam wtedy → we were missing

traps.input: We was missing acceptance criteria
traps.why: We zawsze z were: we were, they were.

translations.en: I suggest a shorter daily
accept: I suggest shorter dailies
I'd suggest a shorter daily
translations.note: proponuję coś → I suggest, bez przyimka

traps.input: I suggest for a shorter daily
traps.why: Suggest nie potrzebuje for: I suggest a shorter daily.

translations.pl: Bierzemy za dużo zgłoszeń do sprintu
translations.en: We take too many tickets into the sprint
accept: We pull too many tickets into the sprint
We take too many tickets into sprint
translations.note: zgłoszenia da się policzyć → too many

traps.input: We take too much tickets into the sprint
traps.why: Tickets da się policzyć, więc too many. Too much idzie z tym, czego nie liczysz: too much work.

translations.en: Pairing on tests worked well
accept: Pair testing worked well
Pairing during tests worked well
translations.note: sprawdziło się w minionym sprincie → worked

traps.input: Pairing on tests works well
traps.why: Na retro mówisz o tym, co już było, więc worked.

translations.pl: Na następny sprint chcę mniej równoległych tematów
translations.en: For the next sprint I want fewer parallel topics
accept: Next sprint I want fewer parallel topics
For the next sprint I want less work in parallel
translations.note: tematy da się policzyć → fewer

traps.input: For the next sprint I want less parallel topics
traps.why: Topics da się policzyć, więc fewer. Less idzie z tym, czego nie liczysz: less work.

translations.en: We're doing a production swap today
accept: We are doing a production swap today
Today we're swapping production
translations.note: dziś, ustalone → we're doing

traps.input: We do a production swap today
traps.why: Gdy chodzi o dzisiejszy, ustalony plan: we're doing.

translations.en: I run smoke tests after the deploy
accept: I check smoke after the deploy
I run a smoke test after the deploy
translations.note: po każdej wrzutce, czyli zawsze → I run

traps.input: I'm running smoke tests after the deploy
traps.why: To robisz po każdej wrzutce, czyli zawsze: I run.

traps.input: I make smoke tests after the deploy
traps.why: Testy się run albo do. Make w tym miejscu nie chodzi.

translations.pl: Rollback jest gotowy, gdyby coś padło
translations.en: The rollback is ready if something goes down
accept: Rollback is ready if something goes down
The rollback is ready if something breaks
translations.note: gdyby coś padło → if something goes down

traps.input: The rollback is ready if something will go down
traps.why: Po if nigdy will: if something goes down.

translations.en: The maintenance window starts at ten pm
accept: The maintenance window starts at 10 pm
The service window starts at ten pm
translations.note: o której godzinie → at ten

traps.input: The maintenance window start at ten pm
traps.why: Window to ono, więc starts z -s.

traps.input: The maintenance window starts in ten pm
traps.why: O godzinie zawsze at: at ten, at three, at noon.

translations.pl: Na czacie czekam na zielone od deweloperów
translations.en: On chat I'm waiting for a green light from the developers
accept: On chat I am waiting for a green light from the developers
I'm waiting on chat for a go from the developers
translations.note: czekam NA coś → wait for

traps.input: On chat I'm waiting a green light from the developers
traps.why: Czekać na coś to wait FOR: I'm waiting for a green light.

translations.pl: Po podmianie oglądam logi przez godzinę
translations.en: After the swap I watch the logs for an hour
accept: After the swap I check the logs for an hour
After the production swap I watch the logs for an hour
translations.note: jak długo → for an hour

traps.input: After the swap I watch the logs since an hour
traps.why: For mówi JAK DŁUGO (for an hour). Since mówi OD KIEDY (since ten).

translations.pl: Możemy przejść przez ten błąd razem
translations.en: We can walk through this bug together
accept: Can we walk through this bug together
We can go through this bug together
translations.note: przejść przez coś razem → walk through

traps.input: We can to walk through this bug together
traps.why: Po can nigdy to: can walk, can see, can help.

translations.pl: Widzę to u siebie, dam znać jak znajdę przyczynę
translations.en: I can see it on my side, I'll let you know when I find the cause
accept: I can reproduce it, I'll let you know when I find the cause
I see it on my side, I will let you know when I find the root cause
chunks: I can see it on my side
translations.note: dam znać, jak znajdę → I'll let you know when I find

traps.input: I can see it on my side, I'll let you know when I will find the cause
traps.why: Po when nigdy will: when I find the cause.

translations.pl: To nie jest blocker, mamy obejście
translations.en: This isn't a blocker, we have a workaround
accept: This is not a blocker, we have a workaround
It's not a blocker, we have a workaround
translations.note: to nie jest → this isn't a

traps.input: This isn't blocker, we have a workaround
traps.why: Przed blocker trzeba a: isn't a blocker.

translations.en: I'll confirm it on your environment
accept: I will confirm it on your environment
I'll check it on your environment
translations.note: obietnica dana klientowi → I'll confirm

traps.input: I confirm it on your environment
traps.why: Gdy obiecujesz coś w rozmowie: I'll confirm.

translations.pl: Dziękuję za nagranie, to bardzo pomaga
translations.en: Thanks for the recording, that helps a lot
accept: Thank you for the recording, that helps a lot
Thanks for the recording, it helps a lot
translations.note: dziękuję za coś → thanks for the

traps.input: Thanks for the recording, that help a lot
traps.why: That to ono, więc helps z -s.

translations.pl: O której możemy zrobić krótkie demo
translations.en: What time can we do a short demo
accept: When can we do a short demo
What time could we do a short demo
translations.note: o której → what time

traps.input: Which time can we do a short demo
traps.why: O godzinę pytamy what time albo when.

translations.pl: Wrzuć to na Slacka, żebym miała ślad
translations.en: Drop it on Slack so I have a trail
accept: Put it on Slack so I have a trail
Please drop it on Slack so I have a record
translations.note: wrzuć na Slacka → drop it on Slack

traps.input: Drop it on Slack so I will have a trail
traps.why: Po so w takim zdaniu wystarczy zwykłe I have.

translations.en: I'm picking up this ticket from Jira
accept: I am picking up this ticket from Jira
I'll take this ticket from Jira
translations.note: biorę właśnie teraz → I'm picking up

traps.input: I pick up this ticket from Jira
traps.why: Gdy mówisz, co robisz w tej chwili: I'm picking up.

translations.en: I'm in a meeting until eleven
accept: I am in a meeting until 11
I'm in a meeting until 11
translations.note: do której → until eleven; na spotkaniu → in a meeting

traps.input: I'm in a meeting to eleven
traps.why: Do jakiejś godziny zawsze until albo till: until eleven.

traps.input: I'm on a meeting until eleven
traps.why: Na spotkaniu jesteś in: in a meeting, in the daily.

translations.en: I attach a screenshot to the ticket
accept: I add a screenshot to the ticket
I put a screenshot in the ticket
translations.note: załączam DO zgłoszenia → attach to

traps.input: I attach a screenshot into the ticket
traps.why: Załączasz do zgłoszenia: attach to the ticket.

translations.en: After lunch I go back to regression
accept: After lunch I get back to regression
I'll go back to regression after lunch
translations.note: przy posiłkach nie ma the → after lunch

traps.input: After the lunch I go back to regression
traps.why: Przy posiłkach nie ma the: after lunch, before breakfast, after dinner.

translations.en: Ping me when the build goes green
accept: Ping me when the build passes
Ping me when the build is green
translations.note: jak build przejdzie → when the build goes green

traps.input: Ping me when the build will go green
traps.why: Po when nigdy will: when the build goes green.

dictation.en: I found a bug in the login
dictation.note: found — jak find w czasie minionym

dictation.en: Can you review my pull request?
The ticket is ready for testing
I am blocked on this task
We need to fix this before release
